title: Whispers of the Living Room Night

sentences.text: Hush... I feel the first subtle shift creeping into the living room at 03:00, a ghostly indication of 'breath on the glass' at 41.2 %.
Then, after 04:20, the machines began to wake to a profound change, registering a chilling 'cold spot' in the living room.
By 05:00, the presence was undeniable, plunging the air to 16.6 °C, far below the expected range.
And even as the cold lingered, the breath on the glass reached its dramatic peak near 05:40, settling at 41.2 %.
